# Spent/Cost

> บันทึกรายจ่ายประจำ ผ่อนสินค้า และหนี้ เดือนต่อเดือน (a Thai expense, instalment and debt tracker). Each person sees only their own data.

Spent/Cost is a personal ledger for recurring bills, instalments and debts. A subscription such as Netflix and a loan with a progress bar are the same kind of plan; each month gets its own entries to tick off as paid.

## Features

- Monthly dashboard: what is due, what is paid, and what is left
- A calendar of due dates
- Instalments and debts with a progress bar toward the total
- Web Push reminders the morning before a bill is due
- Sign in with email or Google; a PIN screen on the device
- Installable as an app, and the dashboard opens offline

## Pages

- [Sign in](https://expenses.chakkritton.com/login): the only public page; everything else needs an account

## How it works

- Every recurring bill, instalment or debt is a plan; each month gets its own entries to tick off as paid, and the dashboard totals what is due, paid and left.
- Instalments and debts show a progress bar toward their total.
- A calendar shows the due dates of the month.
- Web Push reminders arrive the morning before a bill is due (on iPhone, after adding the app to the Home Screen).
- Installable as an app; the dashboard opens offline.

## Accounts and data

- Sign in with email or Google (Supabase Auth). A PIN screen protects the app on the device.
- The data lives in a Postgres database on the developer's own server, reached through a gateway that checks your session, and row-level security lets each person read and write only their own plans.
- There is nothing public to browse: every page except sign-in needs an account.
